releases.name: Co-create Stories
releases.summary:
Create the character you want and live your own adventure.

Co-create Stories is a single-player AI text RPG where every line and action is entered in your own words. The AI game master responds to what you try and continues the story.

Bribe a guard to enter through the back gate. Fight, flee, persuade, betray, or try something no fixed menu could predict. Every adventure unfolds differently.

releases.name: Bloodspill
releases.summary: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, PvP retro FPS with one hit combat, featuring classic game modes like Deathmatch, Capture the Flag and Conquest

releases.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
releases.summary:
Step into the cockpit and take flight as an elite pilot across stunning skies. Enter intense dogfights, eliminate threats, and rise through gripping missions to earn your wings.

Campaign Mode showcases stunning visuals with dynamic multi-layered cloudscapes that capture the majesty of living skies. Feel the rush of a fast-paced arcade-style gameplay and deploy powerful weapons to dominate the battlefield.

Beyond the chaos in the air, breathtaking first-person scenes reveal your pilot’s story through breathtaking cinematics. Experience the pressure of command, the weight of decisions, and the bonds forged in battle. Between missions, bond with your squad members, rise to meet adversity, and prove yourself as a true ace.

releases.name: Keepshore
releases.summary: A calm 3D island town-builder spanning nine ages, from stone huts to electric streets. Raise workshops, wire production chains, work a living market, and grow a town that keeps producing while you're away. Settle a new island to advance the age — every shore you leave sends tribute home forever.

releases.name: Dream Simulators
releases.summary: Enter the hidden world of fashion with Alice, a top model and fashion expert. Through AI-driven conversation and evolving storylines, discover how fashion shapes identity, culture, and self-expression, and how a woman can become whoever she chooses to be.

releases.name: GODSPEED (Kyrie)
releases.summary:
God gave you two crucifix pistols. Use them to shoot your way out of hell. 

Four arenas, four bosses, and a lot of things in between that want you dead. Think you can make it out?

GODSPEED is a difficult first-person arena shooter about never standing still. You can choose between three difficulty levels, the hardest one is not meant to be fair. Compete for the fastest times and climb the global leaderboards.

releases.name: Intravenous 3: Borderline
releases.summary:
Intravenous 3: Borderline is a completely free standalone prologue to Intravenous 3.

Once hired to protect a corrupt politician, Gideon has now lost everything. What remains is a trail leading back to those responsible - and a simple, uncompromising desire for revenge.

Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the shoes of Gideon, a feared mercenary with nothing left to lose, and carve a bloody path of revenge through deep systemic stealth and brutal tactical gunplay.

releases.name: Sediment
releases.summary:
A pixel-physics sandbox. Fifty materials, and every one of them is physics: sand finds its angle, water freezes, lava crusts into stone, gunpowder blows. 

Build your own materials and worlds, and share them in the Workshop.

releases.name: Sandcastle Battle
releases.summary: Sandcastle Battle ????️ a real build battle.Sometimes, you can think big.Whether you want to build a stunning 1:1 replica of a famous monument or a colossal structure that touches the sky, the limit is your imagination. Grab your tools and bring massive architectural dreams to life.Or sometimes, you can think small. Prefer the micro-scale? Craft highly detailed miniatures, pack entire sprawling cities into a small space, or just keep things wonderfully simple and charming.You can keep it traditional...Grab your bucket and shovel to build those classic, square, and nostalgic beach sandcastles we all know and love. Sometimes, the traditional way is the best way.Or completely outside the box.Why not a towering gothic cathedral? Or a futuristic base? Embrace wild, out-of-the-box themes and sculpt bizarre, mind-bending creations that have never been seen on a beach before.You can take your time...Enter Sandbox Mode to build without any pressure. No timers, no rules, and no themes—just you, the sand, and total creative freedom at your own pace.Or race against the clock!Feel the adrenaline rush of the Competitive Mode! The timer is ticking, the pressure is on, and every single second counts. You'll need to be fast to finish your masterpiece before time runs out.Just relax...Take a break whenever you need. Thanks to Steam Cloud support, you can safely save your worlds and pick up right where you left off, continuing your builds whenever and wherever you want.Or compete with your friends!Gather everyone for the Voting Phase! Explore and judge your friends' creations, hand out your stars, and see who climbs to the top of the leaderboard to claim the ultimate beach victory.We Value Your Experience! ???? Sandcastle Battle is a labor of love, and we deeply value your time and experience. We are actively listening to our community to make the game as fun and smooth as possible. If you encounter any bugs, have suggestions, or just want to chat with us and find other players to build with, we'd love to hear from you!

releases.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in Shenzhen
releases.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Shenzhen ???? in the hand-crafted landscape. ???? Earn tons of achievements. How many ???? can you find? ???? Be quick! ⏱️

releases.name: Get To Orbit
releases.summary:
A 2D pixel-art score-chaser built on real orbital mechanics. 

Launch, pitch over, coast, and circularize into the exact orbit each contract asks for, then hold it for one full lap before the fuel runs out. 

Ten missions, three hulls, and a gold tier tuned past the developers' own autopilot.

releases.name: Blackout (Len Syrudas)
releases.summary: A first-person game about being unable to see. One warehouse, one hundred thousand kilometers on a side, with a single live switch somewhere in it. Clap to light the room for a few seconds; find the switch by ear, following a hum and a ticking relay. Nothing is in here with you.

releases.name: Chalk Paper Scissors
releases.summary: A visual novel/sidescroller about estranged childhood friends, Chalk, Paper, and Scissors. Explore each character's memories in different stylized worlds to find out exactly what happened to their shared childhood plushie, Stuffie all those years ago...

releases.name: Ballad
releases.summary: Ballad is a toy box for melodies: pick one, tweak it or write your own, then get mesmerized by what it looks like, play it, fiddle with it, and share a clip if you want. Compose, visualize, play, record.

releases.name: La maldicion de Max
releases.summary:
After the death of your mother, Sarah, and the fall of the Consortium, you infiltrate the Phoenix Complex seeking revenge. 

Once inside the complex, your main mission changes completely: you must find a way to escape alive. To do so, you'll have to delve deep and thoroughly explore the complex's workers' area, an industrial sector filled with dark corridors, blocked entrances, and traps.

Throughout your journey, Byte's help will be crucial. Together with Byte, you'll have to solve various puzzles and riddles. However, the pressure is constant: while using your ingenuity to solve the enigmas of the environment, you must maintain absolute stealth. Maxin is lurking, stalking around every corner, and he won't stop until he finds you. Avoid drawing attention, hide when necessary, and don't let Maxin kill you on your way out.

releases.name: MarbleGo
releases.summary: Marble GO is a casual pixel RPG with marble combat and gear building. Launch marbles to trigger 20+ effects, defeat monsters, and earn gear & gold via auto-launch idle mode. It offers 7 gear categories, 200+ items & 40+ buffs for custom builds, delivering satisfying collisions and deep progression.

releases.name: Fill That Pig
releases.summary:
Throw coins into a piggy bank and watch it swell until it bursts.

Fill That Pig is a short, run-based incremental clicker: race the clock, shatter bigger pigs, collect porcelain shards, and grow stronger through a branching skill tree.

releases.name: Manaphore
releases.summary:
Manaphore is a Survival Strategy-Horror game inspired by point-and-click games like Five Nights at Freddy's. 

Wield the elements to defend yourself from magical enemies that gain new abilities over the course of this experiment; one that you have control over!

releases.name: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!
releases.summary: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop! is a single-player organizing game set in a chaotic video game store. Sort 4,290 cases by genre and order, fill 96 racks, progress and unlock powerful abilities, and complete 650 parody-filled series - with questionable help from Jeff, the coolest cat ever.

releases.name: Astral shifter
releases.summary: Play as a mysterious mage, clearing falling star clusters on a hex grid with Rubik's Cube-style moves. Meet witches with unique powers, earn their aid, and save the world in a single night! Alongside a lighthearted Story Mode, there's an Endless Mode for chasing high scores.

releases.name: Factorized
releases.summary:
A side-scroller video game about getting revenge on an evil AI by fighting your way through their factory and destroying their machines!

Equipped with your various instruments of vengeance, shoot, drill, and explode the various robotic (and non-robotic) adversaries that stand between you and The Reconstructor.

releases.name: Gym Mop Tycoon
releases.summary:
Mop up sweat, mustard, and other disasters in an increasingly chaotic gym. 

Upgrade your mop, automate the cleanup with robots, unlock ridiculous events, and push your progression further with every reboot.

releases.name: Apocalypse Intern
releases.summary:
It is your first day at the Department of Scheduled Catastrophes. You wanted coffee. Instead, you authorized the end of the world.

With twenty minutes left on the universal countdown, cross a surreal government office, collect three approvals, recover the legendary Form 0-B, and find a supervisor whose lunch break is protected by regulation. 

Technical Support is run by a tired demon. Accounting considers humanity a recurring expense. The only coworker willing to take responsibility is a sentient rubber stamp.

releases.name: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure
releases.summary: Treasure Trove is an organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room. Sort, stack and shelve 8,888 unique items to unlock new skills and abilities. Clear away mountains of gold and jewels as you begin to uncover the secrets that lie beneath...
